offering_description.value: Provides management consulting, technology and analytics, and managed services to healthcare organizations, higher education institutions and commercial businesses. Delivered by consulting teams on a project, time-and-materials or fixed-fee basis, plus some subscription software and digital offerings.

primary_products.value: consulting-related software and analytics platforms; subscription-based digital tools

primary_services.value: healthcare management consulting; technology and analytics consulting; higher education consulting; financial and operational advisory; managed services

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals and health systems, academic medical centers, universities, life sciences and commercial companies; B2G: public universities, state and local government entities

end_markets.value: healthcare; higher education; life sciences; commercial and public sector

revenue_model.value: service fees: time-and-materials consulting and advisory engagements; project or contract: fixed-fee and performance-based engagements; subscription: software and analytics subscriptions and support
revenue_model.category: service fees; project or contract; subscription

value_chain_position.value: service provider: consultants and advisors serving healthcare, education and commercial clients; software / platform: analytics and software tools sold to healthcare and education clients

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, with offices and clients in Canada, Europe, Asia and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: healthcare, education and commercial consulting, digital technology and analytics, and managed services
